LanguageData.CC_Reason_TreesByWalls: {PAWN_nameDef} has noticed {COUNT} grown trees standing right against the colony's walls, near enough to come down on a roof in a storm.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_TreesByWalls: The council marks the {TARGET} trees against the walls to come down. The colony's cutters will fell them.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_TreesByWalls: Tired of waiting, {PAWN_nameDef} marked the trees against the walls for cutting. Cancel the marks if you'd rather keep them.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_SnowWays: Snow lies deep on {COUNT} cells of the ways by the colony's doors, and {PAWN_nameDef} wades through it every morning.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_SnowWays: The council has the {TARGET} snowed-in cells by the doors marked for clearing. The colony's cleaners will shovel them.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_SnowWays: Tired of wading, {PAWN_nameDef} marked the ways by the doors for clearing. Take them out of the snow clearing area if you object.
